meta.title: Training
meta.description: The training sessions your coaches plan for you.

list.note: Sessions your coaches plan for you. Times show in each session’s time zone. You mark a session completed once it has started.

upcoming.title: No upcoming training
upcoming.body: Sessions your coaches plan for you appear here.

history.title: No past training yet
history.body: Completed, cancelled and past sessions appear here.

completed.title: No completed training yet
completed.body: Sessions you mark completed appear here.

cancelled.title: No cancelled training
cancelled.body: Sessions a coach cancelled, or that ended with a coaching relationship, appear here.

unavailable.title: Training isn’t available
unavailable.body: Your training appears here once your fighter profile is complete.

failed.title: We couldn’t load your training.
failed.body: Check your connection and try again.
failed.more: We couldn’t load more sessions. Try again.

aside.planned: Mark it completed once you have done it. You can do that from its start time on, also later.
aside.ended: The coaching relationship ended. This session had already started, so you can still mark it completed.
aside.completed: You confirmed this session. Completed sessions can’t be changed.
aside.cancelled: Cancelled sessions stay in your history and can’t be completed.

missing.title: This session isn’t available
missing.body: It isn’t one of your sessions, or the link is wrong.
missing.aside: Your sessions are the ones your coaches planned for you.

failed.title: We couldn’t load this session.
failed.body: Check your connection and try again.

complete.title: Mark this session completed?
complete.body: {name} sees it as completed, with the time you confirm it. A completed session can’t be changed.
complete.bodyUnnamed: Your coach sees it as completed, with the time you confirm it. A completed session can’t be changed.
complete.failed: We couldn’t reach SimpleFit. It may already be saved: the session shows what was stored. Try again; it is never completed twice.
complete.unavailable: This session isn’t available any more.

notStarted.title: This session hasn’t started yet.
notStarted.body: You can mark it completed from its start time on. Nothing was saved.

cancelled.title: This session was cancelled.
cancelled.body: It can’t be completed any more. Nothing was saved.
